_readme: High and critical advisories that were already in the shipped (non-dev) dependency tree when the audit gate was added on 2026-10-06 (frontend main 31d77000).
.github/scripts/dependency-audit.mjs fails on any high or critical advisory NOT listed here.
To retire an entry: bump the dependency, re-run the gate, and delete the entry. The gate prints a notice for every entry that no longer matches anything.
Never add an entry just to turn the gate green: say why the advisory cannot reach users, or what is tracking the fix.
